slides.headline: A vector database finds things by *meaning*, not keywords.

slides.heading: Start with a list of *numbers*
body: Every piece of text becomes a vector:
a list of numbers that captures its meaning.

slides.heading: Store millions, find the *closest*
body: It keeps millions of these vectors.
Given a new one, it returns the nearest matches.

slides.heading: Search by *idea*, not exact words
body: Keyword search needs the same words.
Vector search needs only the same meaning.

slides.headline: Meaning, turned into numbers, is easy to search.
slides.cta: Which part should the next post explain?
